body.statement: On the cyclic chart \(\det K_0\ne0\), suppose every mean and covariance coordinate of \(\widehat z\) differs from its population counterpart by at most \(\epsilon\) in Euclidean or operator norm, respectively. If \(\epsilon\le\min\{a_0/4,1/c_M,\kappa/(2c_K)\}\), then \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}}=\widehat K_1\widehat K_0^{-1}\) is defined and \(\lVert\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}}-V\rVert\le c_V\epsilon\). If in addition \(\epsilon<\epsilon_{\mathrm{rec}}\), then \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}}\) remains stable and off the principal-logarithm cut, its Stein operator is invertible, and every coordinate of the full plug-in \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{cyc}}=\theta(\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}},\widehat z)\) is defined. If \(\epsilon<\epsilon_{\mathrm{adm}}\), then \(\widehat T_{\mathrm{cyc}}\succ0\) and \(\widehat E_{\mathrm{cyc}}\succ0\), so every dynamical, logarithm, Stein, and covariance-positivity admissibility filter is preserved. Quantitatively, \(\lVert\widehat T_{\mathrm{cyc}}-T_V\rVert\le c_T\epsilon\) and \(\lVert\widehat E_{\mathrm{cyc}}-E_V\rVert\le c_E\epsilon\), and the principal logarithm, equilibrium, and initial-mean coordinates obey linear bounds determined by their resolvent, \(\lVert(I_p-V)^{-1}\rVert\), and the moment error. These domain conclusions concern the reconstruction from perturbed moments; they do not assert the exact population raw equalities for \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{cyc}}\).
body.justification: The rational chart gives a usable estimator on noisy empirical moments without requiring exact sample spectra or exact probe-Gram identities.
body.gap: AaltoLamolineGoncalves2022 gives local sensitivity of a loss minimizer, while KoltchinskiiLounici2017 controls spectral projectors; neither supplies a gap-free rational Krylov bound propagated through Stein and matrix-logarithm recovery for common-noise snapshots.
body.consumer: The \(\texttt{covar\_lin\_dyn}\) consumer receives observable conditioning diagnostics and abstention margins for stable generator recovery.
